name: Farewell to Midnight
source:
Inspired by true events, our protagonist finds themselves seated across from a stranger in the train, whose allure lies as much in her mystery as it does in her conversation. As time stretches into a canvas for reflection and discovery, fleeting moments converge into life-altering revelations.

'Farewell to Midnight' is an introspective slice of life that invites players to explore not just the corridors of an ever-moving train but also the depths of their own aspirations and the courage it takes to move forward.

[From [url=https://xkyanari.itch.io/farewell-to-midnight]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
受到真实事件的启发，我们的主角发现自己坐在火车上的一个陌生人对面，这个陌生人的魅力既在于她的神秘，也在于她的谈话。随着时间延伸成反思和发现的画布，转瞬即逝的瞬间汇聚成改变生活的启示。

《告别午夜》是一段反省生活的片段，邀请玩家不仅要探索不断行驶的火车的走廊，还要探索自己的渴望的深度和前进所需的勇气。

[来自[url=https://xkyanari.itch.io/farewell-to-midnight]itch.io[/url]]
